ingredients.title: Cardamom-infused milk
items: Seeds from 8–10 cardamom pods, lightly crushed

method.title: Sponge
steps: Put the milk and lightly crushed cardamom seeds into a saucepan. Warm gently until steaming but not boiling.
Remove from the heat, cover and leave to infuse for around 20 to 30 minutes.
Strain out the cardamom seeds and stir in the vanilla extract into the milk.
Heat the oven to 170 C fan
Grease and line two 18cm cake tins.
Beat the butter and caster sugar for around 4–5 minutes, until very fluffy.
Add your eggs one at a time
Sift together the flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda and sea salt.
Add the infused milk mixture to your dry ingredients until until well combined
Divide between the tins and smooth the tops.
Bake for approximately around 20/25 minutes making sure to check the oven at 20 minutes first or until golden and a skewer comes out with a few moist crumbs attached.
Cool in the tins for 10 minutes
Once completely cold, slice each cake to give you four layers if your cakes are tall enough.

method.title: Compote
steps: Place the chopped figs in a saucepan over medium-low heat on top of the caster sugar. Cook for around 5–7 minutes , until the figs soften and release their juices.
Pour in the balsamic vinegar and stir gently. Cook for another 2 minutes, allowing the vinegar to reduce and coat the figs, you should now have a lovely syrup.
Once the Figs have completely soften, You can then add the blackberries, lemon juice and salt. Simmer for 5–7 minutes, until the blackberries have soften and release all their juices.
Mix the cornflour with the cold water until smooth. Stir it into the fruit and simmer for 1–2 minutes until the mixture thickens into a slight jam-like consistency.
Transfer to a bowl and allow to cool completely at room temperature.

method.title: Basil-infused cream
steps: Warm 100ml of the double cream with the basil leaves in a pan on low heat until steaming.
Remove from the heat, cover and leave for 20 minutes.
Strain and chill completely.
You won’t need the full amount just enough to create the perfect buttercream consistency, thick and able to hold.

method.title: Buttercream
steps: Mix your butter until smooth and pale in colour
Slowly add your icing sugar to the butter and mix until smooth and fluffy
Add the basil-infused cream mixture, honey and vanilla.
Mix until you have a thick but soft spreading consistency.

method.title: Syrup and assembly
steps: Add your water and honey to a low-medium pan and as it simmers add your crushed cardamom seeds, this should take around 5-10 minutes. Cook until you have a light syrup and strain your syrup to remove the cardamom seeds.

Once your cake slices, Figs and BlackBerry compote are completely cool, you can begin to assemble your cake. Apply a thin layer of your syrup to each layer and once your cake is covered, you can decorate with fresh fruit and fresh basil leaves. Place in the fridge before serving.
